title: Word Break II
summary: Return every dictionary-word segmentation as a sentence; words can be reused and output order is unrestricted.
officialConstraints: s length 1–20; 1–1000 unique lowercase words of length 1–10; answer size at most 100000.
visualizationNotes: Existing parser accepts strings through length 25, beyond the official domain; exponential frame growth still needs bounding.
